chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Muslim band members posing as African diplomats
summary: On tour with Louis Armstrong, two sidemen in turbans got hotel rooms as diplomats until their uniforms gave them away.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Somewhere in Kentucky where I played with Louie -- this is where we had a couple of boys in the band who was Muslims. You know, they belonged to that faith and everything.
So they used to wear their hats, you know, everything like that. These crackers didn't know what was going on.

The cracker would be scared to refuse them, so they would get these rooms, and they'd go in with their thing.
